outputs.exact_statement:
Fix an integer $L>2$ such that $$\label{eq:cycle-length}
 4\delta L>2,\qquad p^{E_p}\mid L\quad(p<P_1).$$ For every $l\ge1$ and every prime $p$, there are $L$ admissible residues $y_0,\ldots,y_{L-1}$ modulo $p^{E_p}$, with repetitions allowed, such that $$y_0+\cdots+y_{L-1}=0\pmod{p^{E_p}}.$$

For every positive integer $l$, finite set $\mathcal P$ of primes at least $P$, and real functions $g,g_v:X_{\mathcal P}\to\mathbb R$, $$Z_{l,\mathcal P}(g)\ge0,
 \qquad
 \left|\mathcal Z_{l,\mathcal P}((g_v)_{v\in V})\right|
 \le\prod_{v\in V} Z_{l,\mathcal P}(g_v)^{1/d}.
 \label{eq:signed-holder}$$

Fix $l\ge1$ and a finite prime set $\mathcal P$ as above. At each prime choose either $\rho_p=\mu_{l,p}$ or $\rho_p=\mu_{l,p}^{\circ}$. Let $g_v:X_{\mathcal P}\to\mathbb C$ be arbitrary functions. If, in one distinguished slot $v$, every Fourier coefficient at a denominator at most $R$ vanishes, where $R\ge1$, then $$\left|\int\prod_{u\in V}g_u(z_u)\,
                  d\bigotimes_{p\in\mathcal P}\rho_p\right|
 \le R^{-\gamma}\|g_v\|_2
                     \prod_{u\ne v}\|g_u\|_{2(d-1)}.
 \label{eq:large-denominator}$$

Let $B\subseteq\mathcal P$, fix $z_B\in X_B$, and let $G:X_{\mathcal P}\to\mathbb C$. For $1\le s<\infty$, $$\|G(z_B,\cdot)\|_{L^s(X_{\mathcal P\setminus B})} \le q_B^{1/s}\|G\|_{L^s(X_{\mathcal P})}.$$ In particular, a Fourier lift or a subfamily of its complete supports satisfies [eq:lift-moments] after specialization with the additional factor $q_B^{1/(2r)}$. The same bound holds after retaining either the remaining denominators at most a given $H\ge1$, or those greater than $H$.

For every integer $b\ge1$ and every Dirichlet character $\chi$ modulo $b$, the Dirichlet $L$-function $L(s,\chi)$ has no zero in $\Re s>7/8$. This includes imprimitive characters and the trivial character of modulus $1$, whose $L$-function is $\zeta(s)$. A pole at $s=1$ for a principal character is allowed.

Suppose $N$ is sufficiently large, $l\le N^\zeta$, and $D=M_0\prod_{p\in B}p\le N^\beta$, where $B$ is a finite set of primes at least $P$. Let $J_1,J_2:[N]\to\mathbb C$ have modulus at most one and be supported on residue classes $a'_1,a'_2\pmod D$. Assume that $r=a'_2-a'_1\pmod D$ is admissible at $l$ and that $$J_1(x)J_2(y)\ne0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
 x<y\quad\text{and}\quad y-x\notin\mathcal D_l.$$ Set $$\Xi=\{\xi\in\mathbb Q/\mathbb Z:q(\xi)\le H,
       \ q(\xi)\text{ squarefree},\ (q(\xi),D)=1\}.$$ Then, for the multiplier of any directed cycle edge, $$\label{eq:pair-cancellation}
 D\left|\sum_{\xi\in\Xi}\Gamma(\xi)
       \widehat{J_1}_{[N]}(-\xi)\widehat{J_2}_{[N]}(\xi)\right|
 \ll H^{-\gamma/2}.$$

For all sufficiently large $N$, every $l\ge1$, and every set $A\subseteq[N]$ avoiding at $l$, the following holds. Let $B\subseteq\mathcal P_N$ satisfy $q_B\le N^\tau$, and put $$D=M_0q_B,\qquad L_D=\lambda(D),\qquad
 n_B=\left\lceil\frac{N}{L_D}\right\rceil,\qquad
 \Lambda_B=\frac{L_Dn_B}{N},\qquad
 \mathcal S=\mathcal P_N\setminus B.$$ For each $v\in V$, choose $s_v\bmod M_0$ and fix the $B$-coordinates of $G_{s_v}$ arbitrarily, obtaining $g_v:X_{\mathcal S}\to\mathbb R$. Then $$\label{eq:shorter-scale}
 \bigl|\mathcal Z_{l,\mathcal S}((g_v)_{v\in V})\bigr|
 \le\Lambda_B^d\mathcal Y_{lD}(n_B)+O(N^{-\sigma}),$$ uniformly in all these choices. The new scale and normalization satisfy $$\label{eq:shorter-scale-size}
 N^{1/2}\le M_0^{-k}N^{1-k\tau}\le n_B<N,
 \qquad 1\le\Lambda_B\le1+M_0^kN^{k\tau-1}.$$

For all sufficiently large $N$, all $1\le l\le N^\zeta$, every $A\subseteq[N]$ avoiding at $l$, and every good assignment $(s_v)_{v\in V}$, $$\label{eq:descent-cancellation}
 \left|\int\prod_{v\in V}G_{s_v}(z_v)\,
       d\bigotimes_{p\in\mathcal P_N}(\mu_{l,p}-\varepsilon_{l,p})\right|
       \ll N^{-\sigma}.$$ The implied constant is uniform in $l$, $A$, and the assignment.

There are constants $a_0,b_0>0$ and $C_0\ge1$, depending only on $h$, such that for all integers $l,N\ge1$, $$\label{eq:uniform-descent}
 \mathcal Y_l(N)\le C_0l^{b_0}N^{-a_0}.$$
